quote: If a highway has been designed to provide a single center lane to be used only for turning by traffic moving in both directions, the following rules apply: A vehicle may be driven in the center turn lane only for the purpose of making a left-hand turn onto or from the highway.

activation.description: A highway has one center lane designed only for turns by both directions.
activation.source_clause: a single center lane to be used only for turning by traffic moving in both directions

obligation.description: Center-lane driving has the purpose of a left turn onto or from the highway.
obligation.source_clause: only for the purpose of making a left-hand turn onto or from the highway

timing.description: Review the entire original center-lane occupancy and subsequent movement.
